title: Key Tax Updates & Compliance Deadlines for FY 2026-27
description: An essential overview of upcoming direct & indirect tax compliance deadlines, GST filing updates, and statutory changes applicable for the current financial year.
content: Stay ahead of regulatory deadlines with our comprehensive tax calendar and compliance guide for FY 2026-27. This guide covers GST return schedules, advance tax due dates, and updated TDS thresholds.

title: Navigating Transfer Pricing Audits & Documentation
description: In-depth insights into international tax regulations, benchmarking methods, and maintaining robust transfer pricing documentation for multinational enterprises.
content: Transfer pricing compliance requires meticulous documentation of controlled transactions, functional analyses, and arm's length benchmarking. Learn standard defensive audit strategies.

title: Annual Corporate Governance & Statutory Audit Insights
description: Our flagship annual publication analyzing internal financial control frameworks, audit trends, and corporate governance compliance standards.
content: This publication reviews key auditor reporting duties, CARO 2020 reporting mandates, and best practices for strengthening internal financial controls across corporate entities.

title: GST Appellate Procedures & Dispute Resolution Strategies
description: A strategic guide to handling GST show cause notices, drafting appellate submissions, and approaching the Appellate Authority for GST disputes.
content: Understanding the timeline and procedure for filing appeals under Section 107 of the CGST Act is crucial. Explore step-by-step litigation and dispute resolution practices.
